subject: Budget range validation \u0014 Aurora Payments (LLM pricing)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@aurorapayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Budget & token volume follow-up

Hi Alyssa —

Great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can validate the right pricing band for Aurora Payments: 

Call recap (high level):
- Primary use: transaction categorization + customer support summarization (high-throughput, short responses).
- Expected Q4 pilot: ~10k DAU, ~2 requests/user/day, ~avg 750 tokens/request (prompt + response) -> ~15M tokens/day -> ~450M tokens/month (pilot peak).
- Production target (6-12mo): 1.5k DAU -> sorry typo; production target clarification: we discussed a 1.5M monthly requests scenario, but you mentioned production could be 800k–1.2M requests/month depending on fraud seasonality.

Pricing context / unit economics (rough) 
- Redwood suggested model tier: 8k context open model (quantized) with $0.80 per 1M input+output tokens baseline for dedicated pricing (example).
- At 450M tokens/month, that maps to ~$360/month at $0.80/1M — that number is illustrative; production patterns and caching reduce effective tokens.

Concrete asks: 
1) Please confirm the expected pilot monthly token band: is 200M–600M/month accurate?
2) Procurement threshold: does Aurora require PO/contract > $50k to trigger procurement timeline, or is $25k sufficient?
3) Any internal target $/1M tokens you were aiming for (e.g., $200–$1,000 per 1M tokens — note: we can scale discounts by commit).

Attached: redwood-pricing-1Mtokens.xlsx (pricing bands + discount tiers) and a quick template for monthly usage (aurora-usage-estimates.csv).

Next steps: if you confirm the pilot band and procurement threshold, I can draft a committed pilot offer and loop in our finance team for a procurement-friendly quote.

Thanks — talk soon.

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[d] +1 (415) 555-0123 | dylan_brooks@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-pricing-1Mtokens.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: aurora-usage-estimates.csv (csv)]

From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@aurorapayments.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Payments Procurement <procurement@aurorapayments.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Budget & token volume follow-up

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Pilot band: yes, 200M–600M/month sounds right for the pilot window. We anticipate starting around 250–300M/month and spiking to ~500M at peak tests.

2) Procurement threshold: For us, formal procurement routing (legal + PO) kicks in for contracts > $50k. For pilots <$50k we typically can proceed on a simpler SOW/PO without full procurement lead time (good to know).

3) Target $/1M tokens: Our finance/ops team has an internal target of <$600 per 1M tokens for commercial pricing to be considered viable. If we can get into the $300–$600 range with committed volume, that's ideal.

Attached a short note from our finance team that outlines payment windows and approval owners. Let me know if you need any additional detail on usage patterns — we can provide anonymized request logs for the pilot.

Cheers,
Alyssa
Head of Product | Aurora Payments
[Attachment: aurora-finance-note.pdf (doc note)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Budget & token volume follow-up

Looping in quickly —
Dylan, based on their target <$600/1M tokens and pilot band ~300–500M/month, we should be prepared to offer a committed pilot discount to hit their target. If procurement requires >$50k for full PO, we can structure a 3-month pilot at a modest commit (e.g., 400M/month commit) with an option to convert to Dedicated/Reserved pricing after successful pilot.

Can you confirm estimated ARR math and whether we want to include a 15% pilot credit (one-time) to accelerate procurement? If yes, I can approve and we can hand to legal for a simple SOW.

-M

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@aurorapayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aurora Payments Procurement <procurement@aurorapayments.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation — Aurora Payments (LLM pricing)

Thanks Alyssa — and thanks Marissa for the quick review. Actionable next steps below: 

1) Dylan -> Draft committed pilot offer: 3 months, 400M tokens/month commit, with 15% one-time pilot credit applied to month 1 invoice. Estimated commercial price to meet their target: $450 per 1M tokens effective (after commit + credit) which maps to ~$180k over 3 months list -> net ~$153k after credit.
2) Legal/SOW: I'll prepare a simple SOW and send to procurement@aurorapayments.com. Procurement note: since total > $50k, they'll route through procurement/finance; timeline estimate ~2–3 weeks for PO.
3) Tech: If you can share anonymized logs, our solutions engineer will run a quick prefix-caching analysis to reduce effective token usage (could save 20–30%).

I attached an updated pricing worksheet with the commit math and a DocuSign link for a pilot SOW once you confirm.

DocuSign link (preview): https://docusign.redwood.com/RDW-2026-0198-pilot

Let me know if the numbers look right and I'll send the formal quote.

Best,
Dylan
